welcome.tagline:
One selfie. One stranger.
Every day.
welcome.subtitle: Send a selfie, get one back from someone, somewhere in the world. Both are revealed at the same time.
welcome.adultsOnly: For people aged 18 and over only

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Get a sign-in code by email. No password.

birthdate.title: Your date of birth
birthdate.subtitle: BPS is for adults only. It will never be shown on your profile and cannot be changed later.
birthdate.confirmBody: You were born on {{date}}. This date cannot be changed later.

underage.title: Sorry
underage.body: BPS is only for people aged 18 and over. Your account cannot be created.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account has been suspended following a moderation decision. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.subtitle: BPS is built on respect. No nudity, no harassment, no illegal content: every photo is checked and you can report at any time.
terms.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Service
terms.acceptPrivacy: I have read the Privacy Policy and agree to the processing of my data to run the service
terms.acceptRules: I agree to follow the community guidelines

profileSetup.title: Your profile
profileSetup.subtitle: This is what people you swap selfies with will see.
profileSetup.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, "_" and "."

home.title: BPS
home.empty: Your feed is empty for now. Posts from people you follow will show up here. To meet people: the daily selfie (soon) or the QR code (soon).

selfie.title: Daily selfie
selfie.body: Take a selfie: it will be swapped with a stranger's, somewhere in the world.

profile.privateHint: Follow this account to see their photos and stories.
profile.notFound: This profile doesn't exist or is no longer available.
profile.removeFollowerConfirm: Remove @{{username}} from your followers? They won't be notified.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNotTranslated: Translation in progress — English is used in the meantime
settings.privateAccountHint: Only people you approve can see your posts, stories and follower lists.

setup.title: Missing configuration
setup.body: Create apps/mobile/.env from .env.example with your Supabase project URL and key, then restart the app.

errors.photoPermission: Allow photo access in your phone settings
